# arnaud-zg/skills

> A Claude Code plugin marketplace named arnaud-zg-skills: Agent Skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers,
> each linted, tested and versioned. Its first plugin, arnaud-zg, ships hexagonal-skill-builder, a
> linter for Agent Skills (SKILL.md), doc-compass, which writes and checks Diataxis docs,
> radical-simplify, which rebuilds a process, product or UI into its simplest version, 
> glance-first, which presents any work so it reads in under a minute, glance-audit, which challenges a
> doc, plan or PR, skill-retro, which turns session friction into skill fixes, and usage-runway,
> which says whether the next job fits the usage window.

- [Documentation home](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/docs/README.md): skills catalogue, purpose and how each skill works, and a map of every page

## hexagonal-skill-builder: a linter for Agent Skills

A linter and writing guide for Agent Skills (SKILL.md folders loaded by Claude Code and other coding
agents). It checks four rules, named, small, resolves and tested, and prints the file, line and fix
for each finding. Node only, no dependencies, no network, read-only. MIT.

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/skills`
- Install in any agent: `npx skills add arnaud-zg/skills --skill hexagonal-skill-builder`
- Call it: `/arnaud-zg:hexagonal-skill-builder check`, or ask the agent to "check the skills"
- Run it without an agent: `node <skill folder>/scripts/check.mjs [path ...] [--suite <script>] [--json]`

- [README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/hexagonal-skill-builder/README.md): what it is, the four rules, questions
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/hexagonal-skill-builder/tutorial.md): a first skill, checked
- [How-to guides](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/hexagonal-skill-builder/how-to.md): CI, commit hooks, JSON output, splitting a long entry
- [Reference](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/hexagonal-skill-builder/reference.md): command, exit codes, what each rule looks for
- [Explanation](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/hexagonal-skill-builder/explanation.md): why a skill's shape is its behaviour
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/skills/hexagonal-skill-builder/SKILL.md): the instructions the agent follows

## doc-compass: Diataxis documentation that stays true

A writing guide and checker for Diataxis documentation (tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation,
plus decision records). It ships page templates that form a whole docs/ folder, and a check of seven
rules (indexed, resolves, framed, superseded, generated, small, banned) that prints the file, line
and fix for each finding. Node only, no dependencies, no network, read-only. MIT.

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/skills`
- Install in any agent: `npx skills add arnaud-zg/skills --skill doc-compass`
- Call it: `/arnaud-zg:doc-compass audit docs`, or ask the agent to "check the docs" or "document this feature"
- Run it without an agent: `node <skill folder>/scripts/check-docs.mjs [docs folder] [--index <page>] [--ban <text>]... [--json]`

- [README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/doc-compass/README.md): what it is, install, what it reads
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/doc-compass/tutorial.md): a checked docs set from the templates
- [How-to guides](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/doc-compass/how-to.md): CI, banned strings, gravestones, audits
- [Reference](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/doc-compass/reference.md): command, exit codes, rules, templates
- [Explanation](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/doc-compass/explanation.md): why Diataxis, and why these rules
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/skills/doc-compass/SKILL.md): the instructions the agent follows

## radical-simplify: the simplest, fastest version of a process, product or UI

A first-principles method the agent follows in six strict steps: Question, Remove, Simplify,
Reimagine, Accelerate, Automate. It ends with a counted before and after, and the first change to
make. Instructions only, no script, no network. MIT.

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/skills`
- Install in any agent: `npx skills add arnaud-zg/skills --skill radical-simplify`
- Call it: `/arnaud-zg:radical-simplify <target>`, or ask the agent to "make this radically simpler"

- [README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/radical-simplify/README.md): what it is, install, what it reads
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/radical-simplify/tutorial.md): a refund flow cut down in one run
- [How-to guides](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/radical-simplify/how-to.md): screens, code, docs, kept constraints
- [Reference](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/radical-simplify/reference.md): call, steps, rules, output
- [Explanation](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/radical-simplify/explanation.md): why removing comes before automating
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/skills/radical-simplify/SKILL.md): the instructions the agent follows

## glance-first: any piece of work, read in under a minute

A one-minute format: the answer first, the key numbers next, then at most four blocks that each open
on a diagram, chart, table or screenshot marking what changed. A Node script checks the brief before
it is drawn as an artifact page, a pull request body, terminal text or a Markdown file. No network,
no dependency. MIT.

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/skills`
- Install in any agent: `npx skills add arnaud-zg/skills --skill glance-first`
- Call it: ask the agent for a "TLDR", to "write the PR description", or to "present this"

- [README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-first/README.md): what it is, install, what it reads
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-first/tutorial.md): a change presented in one minute
- [How-to guides](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-first/how-to.md): PR body, page, terminal, file
- [Reference](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-first/reference.md): fields, limits, check
- [Explanation](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-first/explanation.md): why the answer, then numbers, then pictures
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/skills/glance-first/SKILL.md): the instructions the agent follows

## glance-audit: challenge a doc, plan or pull request

Reads like a careful sceptic and hands back a one-line verdict, the critical finding with its proof,
and comments anchored on exact quotes, ready to paste. It never posts. glance-first renders it.

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/skills`
- Install in any agent: `npx skills add arnaud-zg/skills --skill glance-audit`
- Call it: ask the agent to "audit this", "poke holes" or "challenge this plan"

- [README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-audit/README.md): what it is, install, what it reads
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-audit/tutorial.md): a first run
- [How-to guides](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-audit/how-to.md): one recipe per task
- [Reference](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-audit/reference.md): fields, flags, check
- [Explanation](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/glance-audit/explanation.md): why it works this way
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/skills/glance-audit/SKILL.md): the instructions the agent follows

## skill-retro: turn session friction into skill fixes

Finds what made a session's skills slow, wrong or expensive in tokens, ranks it by cost, and books
each fix as its own draft pull request in a skills stack.

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/skills`
- Install in any agent: `npx skills add arnaud-zg/skills --skill skill-retro`
- Call it: ask for a "retro" or to "improve the skills" at the end of a session

- [README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/skill-retro/README.md): what it is, install, what it reads
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/skill-retro/tutorial.md): a first run
- [How-to guides](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/skill-retro/how-to.md): one recipe per task
- [Reference](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/skill-retro/reference.md): fields, flags, check
- [Explanation](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/skill-retro/explanation.md): why it works this way
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/skills/skill-retro/SKILL.md): the instructions the agent follows

## usage-runway: does the next job fit the usage window

Reads Claude Code's session records and answers GO or PARK from the clock and any limit already hit.
Read-only, no network.

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/skills`
- Install in any agent: `npx skills add arnaud-zg/skills --skill usage-runway`
- Call it: ask "do we have enough credit?" before long work

- [README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/usage-runway/README.md): what it is, install, what it reads
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/usage-runway/tutorial.md): a first run
- [How-to guides](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/usage-runway/how-to.md): one recipe per task
- [Reference](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/usage-runway/reference.md): fields, flags, check
- [Explanation](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/usage-runway/explanation.md): why it works this way
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/skills/usage-runway/SKILL.md): the instructions the agent follows
